CFML Language Reference: Functions

Min

Compares two numbers and returns the lesser one.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Min(number1, number2)

Parameters

number1
A number.
number2
A number.

Returns

The smaller of the two numbers.

Usage

Min takes exactly two arguments; nest calls for more, or put the values in an array and use ArrayMin. A typical use is capping a value, such as the last row shown on a page of results.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetEmps" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employees
</CFQUERY>
<CFSET StartRow = 21>
<CFSET EndRow = Min(StartRow + 9, GetEmps.RecordCount)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Min(3, 7) = #Min(3, 7)#, Min(-1, -1.5) = #Min(-1, -1.5)#
<P>Showing employees #StartRow# to #EndRow# of #GetEmps.RecordCount#:
</CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetEmps" STARTROW="#StartRow#" MAXROWS="10"><LI>#FirstName# #LastName#</CFOUTPUT>
</UL>

See also

Max, ArrayMin, Abs
